output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, Johnson & Johnson’s most recent completed acquisition was Firefly Bio (July 29, 2026), bought for $1 billion in cash to add its degrader antibody-conjugate oncology platform. It also completed the $3.05 billion acquisition of Halda Therapeutics in December 2025 and the acquisition of Intra-Cellular Therapies in April 2025, adding the CAPLYTA neuroscience franchise. In 2024, major acquisitions included Shockwave Medical, V-Wave, Ambrx Biopharma, Proteologix and Yellow Jersey (the NM26 program); these followed earlier major deals such as Abiomed and Actelion, but the list here focuses on the latest disclosed transactions.
caveats: This is a recent-major-acquisitions summary, not a complete history of every Johnson & Johnson acquisition; the company has made many additional acquisitions over its history.
The 2024 annual report describes Yellow Jersey as an acquisition securing rights to NM26, rather than necessarily a whole-company acquisition.
